As Halozyme Therapeutics (HALO) Valuation Declined, Shareholder Senzar Asset Management Has Lowered Holding by $65.85 Million; Birch Hill Investment Advisors Has Upped Shire Plc (SHPG) Stake by $2.54 Million 
April 18, 2018 - By Jan Rainey 
Senzar Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Halozyme Therapeutics Inc (HALO) by 85.97% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Senzar Asset Management Llc sold 3.29 million shares as the company’s stock declined 6.13% with the market. The hedge fund held 537,500 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.89 million, down from 3.83 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Senzar Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Halozyme Therapeutics Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $2.83B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.10% or $0.02   $19.8. About 195,165 shares traded. Halozyme Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:HALO) has risen 32.10%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 20.55% the S&P500. 
Birch Hill Investment Advisors Llc increased its stake in Shire Plc (SHPG) by 16.25% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Birch Hill Investment Advisors Llc bought 16,408 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.82% with the market. The institutional investor held 117,395 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $18.21M, up from 100,987 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Birch Hill Investment Advisors Llc who had been investing in Shire Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $47.92B market cap company. The stock increased 3.39% or $5.25   $160.34. About 1.11 million shares traded. Shire plc (NASDAQ:SHPG) has declined 27.67%   downtrending. It has underperformed by 39.22% the S&P500. 
Among 27 analysts covering Shire plc (ADR) ( NASDAQ:SHPG ), 22 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 5 Hold. Therefore 81% are positive. Shire plc (ADR) had 76 analyst reports since July 22, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The company was maintained on Friday, September 22 by Cowen & Co. The firm has “Sector Perform” rating by RBC Capital Markets given on Tuesday, January 12. On Friday, June 3 the stock rating was reinitiated by Morgan Stanley with “Overweight”. Stifel Nicolaus maintained Shire plc (NASDAQ:SHPG) on Tuesday, January 2 with “Buy” rating. The stock has “Buy” rating by Bank of America on Wednesday, March 28. On Thursday, May 26 the stock rating was initiated by Stifel Nicolaus with “Buy”. RBC Capital Markets maintained it with “Sector Perform” rating and $248 target in Monday, October 26 report. The rating was maintained by Cantor Fitzgerald with “Buy” on Friday, June 30. FBR Capital maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Friday, February 23 report. As per Friday, January 5, the company rating was maintained by Cowen & Co. 
Birch Hill Investment Advisors Llc, which manages about $1.24 billion and $1.21 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Schlumberger Ltd (NYSE:SLB) by 15,603 shares to 100,099 shares, valued at $6.75 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Celgene Corp (NASDAQ:CELG) by 3,021 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 316,776 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL). 
Senzar Asset Management Llc, which manages about $442.00 million and $391.71 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Endologix Inc (NASDAQ:ELGX) by 1.29M shares to 2.20M shares, valued at $11.75M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Aerie Pharmaceuticals Inc (NASDAQ:AERI) by 47,200 shares in the quarter, for a total of 278,400 shares, and has risen its stake in Ironwood Pharmaceuticals Inc (NASDAQ:IRWD). 
Analysts await Halozyme Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:HALO) to report earnings on May, 10 after the close. They expect $-0.21 earnings per share, up 19.23% or $0.05 from last year’s $-0.26 per share. After $0.85 actual earnings per share reported by Halozyme Therapeutics, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -124.71% negative EPS growth. 
By1 Jan Rainey
